comment.author: pandysp
comment.body_excerpt: If your Gateway runs as a systemd `--user` service, as `openclaw daemon install` sets it up, it can't be bound to `tailscaled.service` dir ... led.service`. We run this on production (2026.9.8, Ubuntu 24.04.5), but haven't yet seen it fire on a Tailscale restart outside a reboot.

reasons: On-topic systemd workaround with configuration, setup commands, and explicit testing limitations.
